normal:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single static transparent game character asset for our garden tower defense game.
The reference image is STYLE ONLY, not a character to reproduce. Create ONE ordinary cartoon zombie full body, facing LEFT in a side/very slight three-quarter gameplay view, walking toward plants on the left. Match the reference's beautifully painted soft 3D volumes, warm upper-left golden sunlight, tactile matte surfaces, charming rounded proportions, clean readable silhouette, refined painterly surface detail. Family-friendly comic zombie, sage gray-green skin, large rounded bald head with a few sparse hairs, big cream eyes with tiny pupils looking LEFT, slightly slack jaw with two blunt visible teeth, goofy rather than scary, oversized hands and shoes. Torn warm brown blazer, cream shirt, loose muted red tie, blue-gray worn trousers, dark brown shoes. Lean slightly forward with both forearms extended LEFT, two separated feet in a stable neutral walking-ready pose. Not graphic, no wounds, no blood. This is the base design for six later costume variants; make the anatomy simple and coherent.
Composition: one full character centered on a SQUARE transparent canvas, head at 12% height, soles at 88%, comfortable margins on all sides; entire fingers shoes and hair visible, no cropping. Fixed orthographic camera, constant 3D character scale, no foreshortening. No plant, no backdrop, no scenery, no floor, no ground shadow, no text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no sprite sheet. True transparent alpha, not checkerboard. One finished production-quality static image.
